parameters.query:
SELECT
    airtable_record_id,
    notion_page_id,
    last_synced_at,
    last_airtable_modified_at,
    last_notion_edited_at,
    conflict_count,
    current_status
FROM airtable_notion_sync_state
ORDER BY airtable_record_id;

INSERT INTO airtable_notion_sync_state (
  airtable_record_id,
  notion_page_id,
  last_synced_at,
  last_airtable_modified_at,
  last_notion_edited_at,
  conflict_count,
  current_status
) VALUES (
  '{{ $('Write to Airtable').item.json.body.id }}',
  '{{ $('Split: Airtable Writes').item.json.notion_page_id }}',
  NOW(),
  '{{ $('Write to Airtable').item.json.body.fields['Last Modified'] }}'::timestamptz,
  '{{ $('Split: Airtable Writes').item.json.current_notion_edited }}'::timestamptz,
  0,
  'active'
)
ON CONFLICT (notion_page_id) DO UPDATE SET
  airtable_record_id = EXCLUDED.airtable_record_id,
  last_synced_at = EXCLUDED.last_synced_at,
  last_airtable_modified_at = EXCLUDED.last_airtable_modified_at,
  last_notion_edited_at = EXCLUDED.last_notion_edited_at,
  current_status = 'active';

INSERT INTO airtable_notion_sync_runs (
  run_started_at, run_completed_at, status,
  records_created, records_updated,
  conflicts_detected, conflicts_flagged,
  errors_count, conflict_details
) VALUES (
  NOW(), NOW(),
  CASE WHEN {{ $('Merge & Classify').all().length }} > 0 THEN 'success' ELSE 'success' END,
  {{ $('Merge & Classify').all().filter(i => i.json.operation === 'create').length }},
  {{ $('Merge & Classify').all().filter(i => i.json.operation === 'update').length }},
  0, 0, 0, NULL
);
